implementation_intent: Implement boundary_weighted_loss_v1 in train.py with deterministic weights derived only from supplied payoffs and backward targets; keep manifest.json unchanged and compare against a uniform-loss matched control using the same architecture, seed, updates, and artifact protocol.; mechanism=residual_continuation_v1: Train the fixed MLP on continuation residuals relative to a simple intrinsic or affine baseline, then reconstruct the continuation value.
negative_constraints: Candidate source is sealed before evaluation; only train.py and manifest.json are editable.
Every training cell receives one evaluator-owned instance and its training paths, never pricing or audit paths.
The candidate exports data-only artifacts; the trusted runner is stateless, deterministic, finite, and bounded.
The evaluator freezes each per-instance policy before independent pricing and owns every stopping decision.
Public search uses paired common-random-number differences against the fixed legacy Ridge baseline.
Private audit derives hidden products and domain-separated fit, pricing, outer, and inner streams from a sealed seed.
Raw primal-dual bound-order diagnostics are preserved; no candidate-reported metric is trusted or clipped.
success_criterion: At least one guided candidate exceeds its matched control in paired_lower_bound_lcb on the frozen public suite with finite status.
